tools.name: studio_get_state
tools.description: Read bounded connection, document, controller-predicate, and Play-transition state from one explicitly targeted Studio session. available_datamodel_types lists only general-operation request channels that are actually routable through v2; the lifecycle-only PlayServer bridge is never reported as a Server or Client route.

tools.name: studio_list_tree
tools.description: Query a bounded, deterministic descendant tree beneath one exact Studio instance path. Optional filters use literal matching only. The response retains root_path, items, truncated, max_depth, and max_results for compatibility and adds returned, scanned, scan_limit, page_size, has_more, continuation_cursor, and the normalized filters. A returned continuation_cursor is opaque and bound to the explicit Studio session, document epoch, generation, query, ordering, and continuation lineage.

root_path.description: Exact child-name segments from the DataModel root; an empty array means the DataModel.

max_depth.description: Maximum descendant depth. The root_path segment count plus max_depth must not exceed the shared 64-segment reusable path bound.

max_results.description: Legacy page-size alias retained for compatibility. Range 1 through 500. Do not combine with page_size.

name_filter.description: Literal substring matched against Instance.Name, case-insensitive for ASCII letters and byte-literal for other UTF-8. Patterns and control characters are not accepted; the UTF-8 encoding is limited to 100 bytes.

class_filter.description: Case-sensitive literal Roblox class name identifier. Uses exact ClassName equality unless class_is_a is true; the UTF-8 encoding is limited to 100 bytes.

class_is_a.description: When true, evaluate class_filter with Instance:IsA instead of exact ClassName equality. Invalid unless class_filter is supplied.

scan_limit.description: Maximum number of deterministic traversal candidates examined in this call. Default: 2000.

page_size.description: Maximum number of matching items returned in this page. Default: max_results when supplied, otherwise 200. Do not combine with max_results.

continuation_cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a prior page for the same explicit Studio session, client, document epoch, generation, root, filters, depth, limits, ordering version, and unchanged continuation lineage. Never construct or reuse it for another query.

tools.name: studio_inspect_instance
tools.description: Inspect one exact, unambiguous Studio instance in Edit mode through a fixed reviewed property allowlist. The closed response includes safely encoded allowlisted properties, bounded attributes and tags, a deterministically sorted immediate-child summary, and a depth-, scan-, time-, and output-bounded descendant class count. It never reflects arbitrary properties, reads script source, accepts dot-path expressions, or exposes Roblox security identities.

path.description: Exact child-name segments from the DataModel root. Duplicate sibling names make the path ambiguous and fail closed.

descendant_max_depth.description: Maximum descendant depth included in the bounded count. The target path segment count plus this value must not exceed 64. Default: 64 minus the target path segment count.

descendant_scan_limit.description: Maximum descendants examined for class counts. Default: 2000.

time_limit_ms.description: Internal cooperative work budget including exact-path resolution. Default: 3000.

tools.name: studio_search_scripts
tools.description: Search script names with bounded literal ASCII-case-insensitive all-keyword matching beneath one exact Studio instance path. Results use deterministic pagination and an opaque continuation cursor fenced to the explicit session, document, generation, query, ordering, and continuation lineage.

keywords.description: Printable-ASCII comma-separated literal keywords. The normalized query contains from one through eight non-empty keywords, each at most 64 bytes.

root_path.description: Exact child-name segments from the DataModel root; an empty array means the DataModel.

continuation_cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a prior page for the same explicit session and exact query.

tools.name: studio_grep_scripts
tools.description: Search bounded script source bytes for one literal query beneath one exact Studio instance path. Results use deterministic pagination, bounded previews, revision hashes, and an opaque continuation cursor fenced to the explicit session, document, generation, query, ordering, and continuation lineage.

query.description: Printable-ASCII literal source substring; Luau patterns and regular expressions are not accepted.

root_path.description: Exact child-name segments from the DataModel root; an empty array means the DataModel.

continuation_cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a prior page for the same explicit session and exact query.

tools.name: studio_read_script
tools.description: Read bounded editor source and its SHA-256 revision from one exact LuaSourceContainer path.

tools.name: studio_update_script
tools.description: Compare-and-swap one exact LuaSourceContainer using the current SHA-256 revision before applying bounded source.

tools.name: studio_multi_edit
tools.description: Apply one closed, revision-protected multi-script edit plan in Edit mode through an internal prepare/apply transaction. Every target is an existing exact, unambiguous LuaSourceContainer path with a required lowercase SHA-256 revision. The plugin preflights every target and every ordered edit before mutation. Targets execute in input order and each target's edits execute in input order against the preceding edit's result. Creation is not supported. The operation provides per-target compare-and-swap and compensating rollback, not cross-script atomicity. A dispatched mutation that cannot be proven applied or rolled back returns recovery_required and quarantines further mutation until explicit recovery proves a safe terminal outcome. Bounds enforced independently by the host and Studio include 1-16 unique targets, 1-64 edits per target, 128 edits total, 1024 expanded replacement spans total, 8192 aggregate UTF-8 path bytes, 262144 aggregate UTF-8 literal bytes, 350000 canonical public argument bytes, 262144 source bytes per target, 1048576 aggregate original and planned source bytes, and 100000 encoded receipt bytes.

datamodel_type.description: The only permitted DataModel request channel. The explicitly targeted Studio session must positively expose Edit.

targets.description: Existing scripts in deterministic input order. Paths must be unique. Across all targets there may be at most 128 edits, 1024 expanded replacement spans, 8192 UTF-8 path bytes, 262144 UTF-8 bytes of old_string plus new_string literals, 350000 canonical public argument bytes, and 1048576 bytes each of original and planned source.

path.description: Exact child-name segments from the DataModel root. Each segment is also limited to 100 UTF-8 bytes. Duplicate sibling names make the path ambiguous and fail closed.

expected_sha256.description: Exact lowercase SHA-256 revision of the editor source that must still exist at prepare and apply.

edits.description: Ordered edits applied sequentially to this target's preflight source. Every old_string must match the current intermediate source exactly; creation and an empty old_string are rejected.

old_string.description: Nonempty exact UTF-8 text to replace, independently limited to 262144 encoded bytes.

new_string.description: Replacement UTF-8 text, independently limited to 262144 encoded bytes and required to differ from old_string.

replace_all.description: When true, replace every non-overlapping occurrence in the current intermediate source. Defaults to false and cannot be combined with byte offsets.

start_byte.description: Optional zero-based inclusive UTF-8 byte offset into the current intermediate source. Must appear with end_byte, cannot be combined with replace_all=true, and must begin an exact old_string match.

end_byte.description: Optional zero-based exclusive UTF-8 byte offset. Must appear with start_byte; the range must be nonempty and exactly the encoded byte length and content of old_string.

observed_before_sha256.description: Observed source revision immediately before this target's apply decision. Empty means the revision was unavailable or could not be proven; the corresponding status must be recovery_required, or not_applied for an aborted_preflight outcome.

observed_after_sha256.description: Observed source revision after this target's apply or compensating action. Empty means the revision was unavailable or could not be proven; the corresponding status must be recovery_required, or not_applied for an aborted_preflight outcome.

tools.name: studio_recover_multi_edit
tools.description: Recover one exact, previously accepted multi-edit transaction for the explicitly targeted Studio session. The original studio_id, client_instance_id, document_epoch, transaction ID, prepare generation, prepare request, revisions, and prepare receipt remain immutable. After an authenticated same-runtime, same-document reconnect, recovery may run under the new fenced generation and its recovery receipt binds that current generation; it never adopts another runtime, document, or transaction. Recovery never guesses success: it proves the current revision of every target, performs only the transaction's pre-authorized compensating action when safe, and otherwise returns recovery_required while mutation remains quarantined.

transaction_id.description: Canonical transaction UUID returned by studio_multi_edit_v2 for this same explicit Studio identity.

observed_before_sha256.description: Observed source revision immediately before this target's recovery decision. Empty means the revision was unavailable or could not be proven; the corresponding status must be recovery_required.

observed_after_sha256.description: Observed source revision after this target's recovery action. Empty means the revision was unavailable or could not be proven; the corresponding status must be recovery_required.

tools.name: studio_set_attribute
tools.description: Compare an exact prior attribute state, then create, replace, or remove one bounded primitive attribute.

tools.name: studio_get_console
tools.description: Read a bounded tail of Studio log history from one explicitly targeted Studio session.

tools.name: studio_capture_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a permission-gated bounded Studio screenshot and return PNG bytes as base64.

tools.name: studio_fire_input_binding
tools.description: Fire one existing Scriptable InputBinding at an exact Studio path; this cannot inject keys, mouse input, OS input, or Studio UI input.

tools.name: studio_start_stop_play
tools.description: Accept one guarded Start or Stop transition in the explicitly targeted Studio session. Start returns a correlated starting receipt and Stop returns a correlated stopping receipt; observe studio_get_state_v2 until the exact transition reaches Play or Edit.
